# Faithnancial

> A private, invite-only investment network for long-term wealth building through curated startup portfolios and collaborative capital allocation.

Faithnancial is a non-commercial investment club platform designed for members to review deals, track startup investments, and grow together through intentional collaboration. The network operates on a 100% equity model with proportional pledge amounts and requires a 70% majority for deal approvals. Membership is curated and invite-only, with a public waitlist for prospective members.

## Pages

- [/](/): Home page with the Faithnancial Network waitlist and overview of the investment framework and ecosystem.
